nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Light Gel Cream

segments.oily: Most oily-skin reviewers say the gel is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and reduces the mid-day oil slick and shine, though two reviewers with oily skin say it did not control oiliness and left them greasy by end of day.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally find it too light to be sufficiently moisturizing on its own and layer it with a heavier cream or lotion, though one reports it healed dry, cracked skin within a week and another with dry-combo skin likes it as a light layer.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers mostly like the lightweight feel and describe it as balancing, though a couple found it too light for their skin type, especially in winter.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive mostly report no irritation and no scent, calling it gentle and well-suited to sensitive or reactive skin, though one sensitive-skin reviewer had a reaction (burning, itching) and another with sensitive skin flagged potentially irritating ingredients before even trying it on her face.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her early 40s and one in her mid-30s describe it as a good lightweight, non-clogging summer moisturizer, though not very moisturizing on its own.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers in their 30s-40s mention using it as a light daytime layer that doesn't clog pores, but none report specific anti-aging effects.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers call it hydrating and soothing with quick absorption, but a substantial number of dry or dehydrated-skin reviewers say it is not hydrating enough alone and need to add a heavier moisturizer or lotion on top.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers credit the centella/aloe/witch hazel formula with calming redness and irritation, with no reports of increased redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes it as forming a protective barrier against irritation; no negative barrier reports.
concerns.spots: One reviewer mentions it may help fade dark spots and niacinamide-related brightening; not a widely discussed concern.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in acne/scarring over time, but one reviewer reports a severe full-face fungal acne breakout after two uses despite fungal-acne-safe claims.
concerns.oiliness: Many oily-skin reviewers say it reduces shine, mattifies, and controls oil through the day, but at least two say it did not help with oiliness and left their face greasy by midday.

aspects.libelle: Pairs well under makeup and sunscreen

extraits.texte: I love other products in the Centella line, so I wanted to love this one, but it just didn't agree with my skin. It wasn't quite hydrating enough and still left me very oily at the end of the day, though slightly less than normal. The kicker was the severe, full face fungal acne breakout I got after two uses, despite having FA safe ingredients.

extraits.titre: For what it is, it's good.
extraits.texte: I'm mid 30s, combo oily skin, fungal acne/seb derm sufferer. I was looking for a daytime moisturizer because I prefer mineral sunscreens and wanted something light underneath my drying sunscreen. Keeping in mind that this moisturizer is formulated to prevent acne and breakouts, it's well formulated for that. Feels like thick water, absorbs well, and gives my skin that extra dose of hydration that i was looking for. What this really is not: super hydrating, creamy, or packed with skin conditioners. It's perfect for humid conditions, plays well with makeup, and feels nice while putting it on. It is very much a day moisturizer and meant for layering with soothing or milky toners, ampoules, and/or essences. Hyaluronic acid products would go well with this. FA safe.

extraits.titre: Good product, but leaves me wanting more
extraits.texte: I have acne prone oily skin that is extremely dehydrated on the daily, and was hoping this cream would help with the tightness and overproduction of oil i experience. To start off, this gel is super lightweight and sinks in very easily. It doesnt bother my acne nor does it make it worse. Since its fragrance free I experienced no irritation, and it doesnt have any noticable scent. Its lovely to apply and i look forward to using it! Unfortunately though its not as hydrating as I wanted it to be. Despite using a hydrating cleanser and milky toner before this cream, i still need to apply a lotion afterwards. Next time I will try their blue skincare line, hopefully that'll help with my skin tightness!

I can't attest to any minimization of pores, despite being on my second tube, but this was a rebuy for a few reasons. One: it's very good for oily skin. Two: Doesn't pill, blends well with whatever sunscreen and makeup I put on top. Three: It's not super scented. Another Korean gel cream caused me to have an allergic reaction, I'm grateful for this basic moisturizer. And four: a little goes a long way. You only need the smallest dot to cover your face after your toners and serums in the morning, and it goes to work! That said, this price isn't it. I recommend buying only on sale or with double points -- this brand even sells for a lot less directly. But I'm glad to see it in Ulta stores now, as I started using it before Ulta even carried it and I'm a fan of the Skin1004 lineup -- simple products that really use centella well.

This moisturizer is mostly recommended for oily skin as it doesn't leave much of an occlusive layer and soaks in pretty quick. I have dry combo skin and I actually really like this product and use it all the time. It reminds me more of a gel or serum though, like the ordinary serum or the Neutrogena hydro boost. If you have dry skin you can use this and add another moisturizer on top when you need it. I have some sensory sensitivities related to autism and I don't like super occlusive products because it makes me feel weird so this product also helps with that. The Centella also helps calm down any breakouts or irritation.

I received this for free in exchange for my honest review. I love the way this moisturizer feels. It has a thick gel consistency and glides onto on my skin and absorbs quickly. The aloe and the witch hazel definitely gives this a soothing and cooling effect that feels so good. My skin is left feeling hydrated all day long. I have sensitive acne prone skin and this does not irritate my skin at all. I don't notice a scent and the packaging is so cute.
My skin did not like this product. It made my skin burn and itch. Definitely not for everyone.
